plan: Keep authoritative session data as a plain dict with exactly the four contract keys, reset via a single _initial_session() factory so begin/abandon produce identical clean states.
Copy the appointments sequence (and each entry) at construction so external mutation cannot alter emitted choices.

Centralize presentation in a _screen(prompt, messages) builder that attaches the appointment choice list exactly when the prompt is 'Choose appointment' and empty lists otherwise, guaranteeing deterministic screen shape.

Dispatch handle(action) through per-type handler methods; each validates preconditions (active/incomplete session, value types, known ids) before any mutation, returning an _error screen whose first message starts 'Error:' on failure so accepted data is never corrupted.

Derive post-action prompts per contract: 'Confirm contact' after begin, confirmed-dependent prompt after contact, next-unmet prompt after correction, 'Review and complete' after choice, 'Check-in complete' with ['Checked in'] on completion, 'Session abandoned' with ['Check-in abandoned'] on abandon.

Implement run_once() to raise RuntimeError before touching either port if source or sink is missing, then read one action, handle it, display the resulting screen exactly once, and return that same object—ports are constructor-injected duck-typed objects replaceable by unittest fakes.
